name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began in his teens, tinkering with go-karts in his hometown. He honed his mechanical skills through apprenticeships at local garages, eventually landing a role at a small racing team. There, he quickly discovered his knack for coordinating testing schedules and interpreting driver feedback into actionable improvements. His meticulous approach and talent for spotting subtle issues caught the attention of PEX Motorsport, where he now manages the test driver program.

Ricardo is known for his pragmatic problem-solving and ability to remain calm under pressure, essential qualities in the high-stakes world of motorsport testing. He's dedicated to ensuring that every test session yields maximum value, carefully analyzing data and collaborating closely with engineers and drivers to optimize performance. His innovative mindset drives him to constantly seek new ways to improve testing methodologies and efficiency.

Ricardo is distinguished by his commitment to fostering open communication between the testing team and the wider PEX Motorsport organization. He believes that clear and concise information flow is crucial for continuous improvement and success on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade
physical.description: Ricardo has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on using a specific type of stopwatch for timing test runs.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
